description: Color-based detection that returns exactly one region selected by contour-area density. Supports runtime switching between most-dense and least-dense selection without a pipeline restart.

camera_bus_id.description: Camera USB bus ID used to resolve calibration files (for example: '0' or '0-1').

target_size.description: Target size for square letterboxed image. Frame will be resized maintaining aspect ratio and padded to this size.

color_ranges.description: List of color ranges for detection. Each entry contains name, class_id, and HSV bounds.

class_id.description: Integer class identifier for the color

lower_hsv.description: Lower HSV bounds as [H, S, V]. H: 0-179, S: 0-255, V: 0-255

upper_hsv.description: Upper HSV bounds as [H, S, V]. H: 0-179, S: 0-255, V: 0-255

min_area.description: Minimum contour area in pixels to consider as valid detection. Smaller contours are filtered out as noise.

max_area.description: Maximum contour area in pixels to consider as valid detection. Larger contours are filtered out.

blur_kernel_size.description: Gaussian blur kernel size for noise reduction. Must be odd number. Set to 0 to disable blurring.

morphology_kernel_size.description: Kernel size for morphological operations (opening and closing) to clean up masks. Must be odd number.

morphology_iterations.description: Number of iterations for morphological operations. Higher values provide more aggressive noise removal but may affect detection quality. Set to 0 to disable morphological operations.

selection_mode.description: Which candidate to select after thresholding. 'most_dense' returns the largest-area region; 'least_dense' returns the smallest-area region.
